geometric.construction: exact Phase-4 MARKOV_M4_K2 state law; equivalent to geometric independent-state refresh with hazard 1/2

semi.construction: iid refresh blocks D in {2,4}, P(D=2)=2/3, P(D=4)=1/3; independent fair state per block

geometric.construction: exact Phase-4 MARKOV_M5_K2 state law; equivalent to geometric independent-state refresh with hazard 2/5

semi.construction: iid refresh blocks D in {3,5}, P(D=3)=5/8, P(D=5)=3/8; independent fair state per block

arms.tau_identity: For iid independent-state refresh blocks with duration D, tau_int=E[D^2]/E[D]. The semi-renewal supports are chosen exactly to equal tau=3 or 4. The geometric-refresh representation is distributionally equivalent to the corresponding Phase-4 binary Markov state sequence.

execution_guard.rule: Workflow file is committed last. Freeze verifies protocol hash, exact Phase-4 persistence blob, compiles Phase-6 code, and runs target-free dwell-law self-tests before any target scorer is restored.

invariants.document_rule: canonical ReM documents with >=2000 clean tokens; use first 2000
invariants.state_application: same Phase-4 K2 within-token rotation offset rule
invariants.state_process_continuity: state sequence continuous across artificial line boundaries; no reset at line boundaries

parent_phase5.interpretation: Short-lived state survives W6-W20 but deterministic fixed blocks show material line interaction; the preferred tau remains short rather than scaling with W.

primary_test.law_matters_nonmonotonic_rule: At least one tau has FG 95% CI excluding 0, but the preregistered monotone regularity-gradient rule is not met.
primary_test.materiality_basis: Inherited prospectively from the Phase-4 same-law control upper 95% CI 0.0361, rounded up to 0.04; frozen before Phase-6 target scoring.
primary_test.metric: robust d3 = worst ATOMIC/LITERAL distance_of_median_Q3; lower is better

paired_differences.FG: d3_geometric - d3_fixed; positive means fixed/regular refresh is better
paired_differences.FS: d3_semi - d3_fixed; positive means fixed is better than semi
paired_differences.SG: d3_geometric - d3_semi; positive means semi is better than geometric

primary_test.regularity_gradient_rule: At a tau, FG lower 95% CI > +0.04 and both FS and SG lower 95% CIs >0; this requires a material endpoint effect with the semi-renewal law statistically ordered between fixed and geometric.
primary_test.tau_sufficient_rule: For both tau=3 and tau=4, all three pairwise-difference 95% CIs lie wholly inside [-0.04,+0.04].

replication_guard.rule: For each endpoint arm, recompute the Phase-5 arm-summary median on the exact common-document rule and require absolute difference from the frozen Phase-5 W10 value <=1e-12.

scientific_question: At fixed short integrated correlation time tau_int in {3,4}, does the regularity/renewal law of the latent K2 origin state materially affect Voynich-target fit, or is tau_int alone sufficient?

secondary.target_free_state_law_validation: verify exact support probabilities/moments and long-sequence empirical lag autocorrelation before any scorer is restored

seeding.phase4_endpoint_state_seed: seed_of('P5-state',doc,replicate) to reproduce FIXED_RUN3/4 and MARKOV_M4/5 exactly
seeding.plan_seed: seed_of('P5-plan',doc,replicate) to reproduce the Phase-5 W10 endpoint controls exactly
seeding.semi_state_seed: same numeric P5-state seed, but a disjoint P6-SEMI internal namespace for renewal durations/states
seeding.stat_seed: seed_of('P5-stat',doc,representation,replicate), common across all Phase-6 arms and exact Phase-5 W10 controls
